note: Queue job #7016 (2026-11-11): translated in 25 half-month chunks against a shared CONVENTIONS file and a per-day crib of Cadman verses, then assembled and re-validated (tag sequence, date markers). Scripture from the Kinh Thánh 1925 (Cadman; Take Root vietnamese / ebible vie_kt) Bible text via scripts/bible_mirror.py (Take Root unreachable); `mined` rows were checked as verbatim substrings of that verse. AI-drafted, awaiting native review.

Micah 5:7 (AV) is Cadman Mi-chê 5:6 (Hebrew versification): the Oct 25 promise is quoted verbatim from Cadman 5:6 and cited as Mi-chê 5:6 so a Vietnamese reader finds it; the row is recorded as Micah 5:6. Apr 19: the English cites "Exod. 34:11" for words that are Ezekiel 34:11; the vi cites Ê-xê-chi-ên 34:11 (as the uk edition does). Isaiah 58:9 (Apr 23) is cited in prose; the words quoted beside it, “Có ta đây!”, are Cadman verbatim.
